container_creation_time_usage: Cross-check of acquisition date only; whole-second metadata is not used for the phase alignment.

event_semantics.record_start: Play becomes disabled and Pause becomes active at video 13.066667s. This UI transition is the nominal CFN t=0 anchor, allowing sample/GUI timing uncertainty.
event_semantics.record_stop: Recording controls stop and Save becomes active at video 220.866667s.
event_semantics.idle_start: First visible FPGA IDLE START UTC line matching the downloaded JSON timestamp.
event_semantics.idle_end: First visible FPGA IDLE END UTC line, followed by countdown.
event_semantics.active_start: First visible FPGA ACTIVE START UTC line matching the downloaded JSON timestamp.
event_semantics.active_end: 100/100 is first visible at 218.133333s; ACTIVE END and PASS first appear at 218.2s. The JSON interval ends earlier than printing/writing, so the print event is a cross-check, not the interval endpoint.

review_method: Native video frames inspected around all UI transitions. No phase window was selected by optimizing energy or locating a power-level transition.
limitations: No hardware trigger connects the meter and FPGA; USB/browser/GUI rendering latency is not independently calibrated.
The +/-0.2s common boundary-shift study expresses numerical sensitivity, not a certified upper limit on timing error.
Screenshots enlarge native crops for readability. Full original video is preserved unchanged with SHA-256.
